experiments.question: Cold open (sound first) or announce the question first?
Standard Short (two hints, 2.5 s thinks) or snappy (one hint, 2 s; reveal ~22 s)?
Close on 'How many points did you get?' or 'New quiz every day. Subscribe!'?
Kinetic captions (word lit as spoken, rounded font) or the previous static layout?
Episode numbers in the title and on the eyebrow, or plain?
Points chip as a ladder of dots, or the plain number?
Original Game Boy/DS cry or the modern one (Gen 1-5)?
Rapid-fire: one play, or the sound again on the silhouette plus silent type pills while thinking?
Rapid-fire: five sounds (~35 s) or seven (~45 s)? Judged on 7-day views.
Rapid-fire: spoken 'how many did you get' or a loop-ready caption-only ending?
Two hints or just the Pokédex/field-guide hint?
2.5 s or 2.0 s of thinking time per stage?
Current tempo (+7 % on every line) or a touch faster (+12 %)?
Which voice holds viewers: OpenAI coral / ash / sage, or ElevenLabs Liam?
Long-form thumbnail: silhouettes with a ? or full-colour art?
